$doc: Fixed sizes: control heights, icons, avatars, hairlines and the widths floating things cap at. Not for spacing (that is space.json). bar and bar-compact are a bar's one-line height (design/layout.md §2): a bar never grows taller. v1's frame sizes (packages/ui/src/app): icon-tile 17 (Stuff, a setup tip's badge icon, a phone action), pill-row 19 (a row's pills), time-row 21 (a row's time), chip-lg 27 (the prompt box's project chips), pip 28 (the rail's pick), new-task 38, home-foot 48, action-tile 52 (a phone action), later-offset 68 (Save for later beside Mark done), title-reserve 92 (a row's title end while its quick buttons show), meta-min 100, home-top 140, pick-max 150, details 232 (the task's details column), read 760 (Home's column). And the in-between steps v1 uses in those places (v1-nudge 3, v1-snug 5, v1-tight 7, v1-grip 7.5, v1-indent 10.5): kept as they are, not rounded to the spacing scale (design/foundation.md §2). task-head 60 (an open task's head). The Mac desktop app's room for the window buttons (v1 body.desktop.mac): mac-rail-top 41, mac-strip-top 9, mac-strip-left 22, mac-chips 49, mac-brand 74, mac-back 82, mac-head 98. meta-wide 260 (the narrow pane's branch keeps at least this much beside the project). read-w 860 (v1 --read-w: the wide pane centres its page past it). tests-ring 76 (a tests block's pass/fail ring, v1 .ring). map 300 (a map block's stage and its list, v1 .mp-stage). dialog-xl 900 × dialog-xl-h 680 (v1's Settings modal, .modal.sx), settings-nav 200 / settings-nav-narrow 172 (its nav column, under 820 px), settings-head 58 (its pane head, .sx-top; 57 on a phone). preview 640 (a preview block's stage at most, v1 .pv-stage). ring-thin 1.5px (the gap ring around a logo's dot, v1 auto.css .model-logo.routed).
